sections.heading: Welcome aboard Queen Mary 2
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D guide, not affiliated with Cunard. Queen Mary 2 is an ocean liner known for transatlantic crossings as well as cruises. Check all current onboard details with Cunard.

sections.heading: Official ship and deck plans
sections.body:
Official Cunard Queen Mary 2 ship information and deck plans (internet required): https://www.cunard.com/en-gb/cruise-ships/queen-mary-2
Use Cunard's latest published deck plans and onboard signage.

sections.heading: Deck reference
sections.body: Consult the official Queen Mary 2 deck plan for cabin positions, lifts, accessible routes and venues. Deck locations and facilities can change.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Queen Mary 2 dining includes arrangements linked to stateroom categories, as well as casual and speciality options. Check your booking and Cunard's daily programme for current restaurants, booking requirements and charges.

sections.heading: Entertainment and activities
sections.body: Queen Mary 2 is known for its theatre, planetarium-style presentations, library and enrichment programme. Specific activities and availability depend on the sailing.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check passport, visa and entry requirements for every port, travel insurance, embarkation details, luggage labels, medications and the Cunard boarding instructions.

sections.heading: First day onboard
sections.body: Find your stateroom and muster arrangements, review the daily programme, check dining details and save your cabin/deck notes in this app.

sections.heading: At sea
sections.body: Use My Day and My Cruise to plan activities and keep notes. Confirm opening hours, events and reservations with the ship.

sections.heading: Ports and excursions
sections.body: Record your port plans, meeting points, return-to-ship times and memorable visits. Always follow the ship's official all-aboard time.

sections.heading: Connectivity and offline use
sections.body: Save your plans while connected. Personal records are stored on your device. This app is not linked to Cunard's onboard systems; internet access is needed for external links.

sections.heading: Important disclaimer
sections.body: Unofficial independent passenger companion. Not endorsed by or affiliated with Cunard. All ship details, deck plans, itineraries and prices should be confirmed with Cunard.
